item.title: Greek National Robotics Team competes in Australia
item.description: The Greek National Robotics Team is in Australia for the 27th International Robotics Olympiad (IROC 2025, 17-21 December), nearly a year after Greece celebrated its historic success at IROC 2024 in South Korea, where the team won eight medals and topped Europe.
